title: Neural expectation-maximization and meta-models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We interpret Transformer networks as learned approximations to a hybrid probabilistic-inference procedure that combines max-product Loopy Belief Propagation (LBP) with Expectation--Maximization (EM). In this view, a Transformer performs inference in partially observed Markov Random Fields (MRFs) whose structure and parameters are not given a priori but are inferred from data. We show that self-attention implements a differentiable approximation to max-product LBP on an input-conditioned, dynamically structured MRF, with attention weights encoding learned structural affinities. We further establish an EM correspondence at the level of depth: each layer updates latent representations in an E-step-like forward pass, while the transition $\theta^{(l)} \to \theta^{(l+1)}$ across layers acts as an implicit M-step. translated_title: 神经期望最大化与元模型
translated_abstract: 我们将Transformer网络解释为一种混合概率推断过程的学习近似，该过程结合了最大乘积环状信念传播（LBP）与期望最大化（EM）。在这种视角下，Transformer在部分可观测的马尔可夫随机场（MRF）中执行推断，其结构和参数并非先验给定，而是从数据中推断得到。我们证明自注意力机制在输入条件化的、动态结构的MRF上实现了对最大乘积LBP的可微近似，其中注意力权重编码了学习到的结构亲和性。我们进一步在深度层面建立了与EM的对应关系：每一层在类似E步的前向传播中更新潜在表示，而层间转移θ^(l) → θ^(l+1)则充当隐式的M步。基于这一解释，我们提出了元模型，这是一种设计范式，其中输入生成实例特定的参数……
tldr: 该论文将Transformer解释为最大乘积环状信念传播与期望最大化混合概率推断的可微近似，并据此提出“元模型”这一新设计范式，由输入生成实例特定的参数。
en_tdlr: This paper interprets Transformers as differentiable approximations to a hybrid probabilistic inference procedure combining max-product Loopy Belief Propagation with Expectation-Maximization, and introduces "meta-models," a design paradigm in which inputs generate instance-specific parameters.
